3048.translation: I finally go museum, but e happen say dem close that day. As proverb talk, I make the journey for nothing.

3049.translation: People often quote proverb with -(이)라더니, -다는 말 or -라고 했잖아. Situation wey e comment on dey give meaning, no be literal reading alone.

3050.translation: Check contract again before you sign. Remember advice say tap even stone bridge before crossing.

3051.translation: The person boast say na the smartest, but meeting much better opponent for contest teach am say somebody better always dey.

3052.translation: My friend lunchbox look sweeter, but after we exchange, little difference dey. Na true say other people portions dey look bigger.

3053.translation: Expecting to play well after only one week learning guitar too much. One spoon no fit fill belly, so make we practise small-small.

3054.translation: When two people quarrel and another person dey increase their anger, people use saying about fanning burning house.

3055.translation: Vexing today because seed wey you plant yesterday never bear fruit na like looking for scorched-rice tea inside well.

3056.translation: Even familiar road fit change because of construction. So remember advice to ask for directions even for road wey you know.

3057.translation: Person suggest skipping safety inspection to shorten construction time. At first, earlier schedule look like gain. But once accident happen, work fit stop for months and blame follow. Proverb say if you dey hurry, take longer safe route. Instead of rushing into big loss, following proper procedure fit become faster overall.

3058.translation: For new-worker training, senior explanations face same problem: no matter how detailed, person wey never see actual site fit no understand. Hearing hundred times no reach seeing once. Watching machine work fit make hours of explanation clear within minutes. This no mean explanation useless. Best order na to build basic understanding with site experience, then organise am through explanation.

3059.translation: Two big delivery platforms cut fees and advertise benefits for shop owners during competition. Later, one buy the other, and new operator remove promised benefits. People quote proverb say when whales fight, shrimp back break. But proverb only show harm during fight, no be what happen after winner set new terms for dependent shops. Owners loss no just accidental: structure already designed to make dem depend on one side.

3060.translation: Critics of narrow specialisation call researcher wey focus one field frog inside well. But water come only if well deep enough. Frog problem no be living for well itself; na failing to imagine wider sky. Researcher wey know own field limits fit talk to frogs for other wells, bring new questions back and dig deeper. We need paths between wells, no be filling wells up.

3061.translation: Cultural-heritage institute report say more than half of sites found for last ten years appear by chance during building excavation. People assume say dem know everything under city because e near. Saying dark under lamp point to darkness caused by not looking, no be inability to see. If some attention for distant excavation turn to ground under our feet, plenty heritage fit get protection before damage.

3062.translation: People often say joint research with many leaders go fail. But large collaborations with similar institution numbers produce different results. Difference na whether dem write clearly from start who get final decision power, no be headcount alone. Proverb boat go mountain no be because many people row; na because nobody decide direction. Using am to limit participants therefore identify wrong cause.

3063.translation: People point out say most review-committee members work long for same industry wey dem review. Members answer say review need expertise. Both get sense. Crayfish supporting crab proverb no only accuse bad intention: same environment fit create same judgment standards. Solution no be trusting personal conscience alone or removing every industry expert. Better to disclose interests and include fixed share of people from other backgrounds.

3064.translation: Support-project report give participating youths employment rate as 85 percent. But most jobs na short contracts only during project. Six months after project end, fewer than one in three still dey same workplace. Fine-looking wild apricot need tasting before you know inside. To judge results, look at length of stable employment instead of outside employment rate alone. Still, short jobs fit begin career; no need deny that possibility.

3065.translation: People use childhood-habit proverb support early education. But brain research show say adult brain fit still change. That no mean proverb simply wrong. Childhood habits fit last because people repeat dem without feeling need to change, no be because change impossible. Read this way, habit from age three lasting till eighty warn say early environment quietly narrow later choices; e no declare destiny.

3066.translation: These days, rising prices dey put heavy financial pressure on plenty households.

3067.translation: This revision mix news style, idioms, proverbs, four-character expressions, discourse markers and cultural knowledge for full sentences.

3068.translation: Dem say joy dey follow hardship. After long effort, I finally pass.

3097.translation: Plenty cities now dey run shared bicycles. People value dem for reducing traffic and air pollution. But users leaving bicycles anywhere fit block pedestrians. To solve this, rule wey require return only to designated places necessary.

3098.translation: People criticise this amendment say thorough public consultation need happen before e start work.
